protocol.ancestry: Nested projected edge midpoints stay on parent great-circle edges; angular children partition parent cones in exact arithmetic. Indexed ancestors are checked with direct3x3 solves, normwise FP64 reconstruction and64eps*condition-scaled coefficient guards; condition>1e5 or escaped ancestry aborts. Independent great-circle search and exact spherical triangle solid angles control mapping. No nearest-cell reassignment or interpolation.
protocol.shared_quadrature: One fresh clipped Roche packet per phase/component serves all variants: identical cosine/area/commonparent arrays, mapped through checked ancestry. SHA256 includes rule/commonlevel/phase/component/nodecount and packet bytes. Reference/GPU independently build geometry; hashes and traces must match. Shared maps are checked toFP64 guards, not interval certificates.
protocol.variants: A=field1_correction1;B=field1_correction2;C=field2_correction2. Correction level sets original scalar formula argument seed_degrees/2**level, without changing raw topology or cached pre-correction gravity/centres/normals. Rebuild all original later areas/thermal/reflection/LD/radiance. A→B correction-only,B→C field refinement at fixed correction,A→C total. Off-diagonal correction is a diagnostic ablation, not a validated prior/model fix.
protocol.finite_limits: Common packets remove boundary variation from within-batch field comparisons. Fields remain original finite piecewise-constant parent values. Integration depth/grid changes are separate controls. Straight clipped leaf chords and seven-probe topology rules remain finite/empirical. No continuous-field, interval-boundary, reflected energy balance or continuum posterior certificate.
protocol.thermal: Original intrinsicT4 normalization compared with the same unchanged temperatures on sharedorder4curvedareas. No temperature renormalization or reflection in this independent CPU diagnostic; all areas are SMA².
protocol.hybrid: Original CPU mesh/roots/field ancestry/geometry/clipping plus existing JAX correctedstate/reflection/freshBB emission/weightedLD integration. CK04 uses explicit originalCPU radiance/LD. Reference uses originalCPU fields/reflection/radiance and elementflux arithmetic with this new quadrature. Original faceted wholecurve is a different numerical method.
protocol.domain: Original circular detached unspotted/nonpulsating q[.5,2],spin[.5,1.5],inner radius1e-6..0.25 and geometric/residual guards. Field/correction levels0-2,max20276fieldfaces/star;commonlevel max(fieldlevels)..3,max40000commonfaces/star;1-4uniquevariants,1-8bands,1-128phases. Existing boundary/node caps remain; cap is not peakmemory. Unsupported/resource/numerical failures abort outside prior penalties, never silently coarsen. OriginalCPU/fullfallback routes unchanged.

validation_and_science.parity: All prior3e-13relative raw/component and3e-13/2e-12normalized gates unchanged; per-face original CPU fields checked at3e-13/64eps. Old singleton shared partition exactly matches preceding complete BoundaryBinaryLightCurve in control; original CPUbefore/after identical. Reflected partial/total/non-eclipse, CK04, smalloccultor, q/spin and log/sqrtLD tested.
validation_and_science.guard_development: Initial componentwise inverse-product guard spuriously rejected symmetry axes; directsolve/normwise conditioning and reconstruction checks resolved it. Original616files and scientific parity gates unchanged; independent geometry checks pass. Failed private CPU evidence retained.
validation_and_science.accuracy: Nominal sigma1e-4 and original ln_f=-2 curve comparisons; nominal component preflight independent of nuisance inflation. Finite component enclosures and data-residual cross-term likelihood bounds apply only to computed pairs. Passing boundary distance alone does not qualify accumulated likelihood or continuous fields.
validation_and_science.inference: Fresh original physical serializers/constraints/priors/phase-JDmapping/reducers/repeats/thirdlight/finalmean/noise/density through matched comparison callbacks. Numerical preflights remain outside candidate penalties. Original -inf prior rejection retained. No registered shared-field fitter, optimized physicalfit, converged chain, mixing orESS/sec claim.
validation_and_science.next: Use isolated upstream/correction changes to develop curvature-consistent or demonstrably converged thermal/reflection/radiance fields, and control accumulated likelihood errors before1e-4physicalfit/MCMC qualification.

timing_conditions.curves: Both backends construct/compute/return all three fresh comparison models, same common clipped geometry, alltransfers and raw/normalized/component host curves. Same unit/affinity0-15/Nice10/threads1/FP64. Compilation incurred included; shapes/sources can warm caches. Single measurements, not distributions.
timing_conditions.callbacks: Both complete comparison timers start before physicalserialization/constraints and constructors, then originalprior,prediction callback and density. Both compute all three comparison curves; the fine curve passes original prediction mapping. This is a three-model diagnostic contract, not ordinary one-proposal throughput. Extra coarseboundary preflight and same-candidate mapping-only oracles add to mainwall, not timed as fresh synthesis.
timing_conditions.startup: Mainwall after imports; separate commandwall includes Python/import startup. Pause/resume and unitdevice probes separate. CPUdeveloper timing while production runs excluded from matched evidence.
timing_conditions.cache: No physical model/quadrature cache across candidates. Common packets are deliberately reused only across finite field variants of the same candidate. Mapping-only oracle reuse is disclosed and outside full callback timings.
timing_conditions.inference: No qualified fitting/MCMC acceleration orESS inference from diagnostic batch costs; common CPUgeometry remains a bridge.
